overview: The Great Crusade reaches a turning point as a new Warmaster leads the Emperor’s armies into an uncertain future.
synopsis: Garviel Loken, a captain of the Luna Wolves, serves in Horus’s expeditionary fleet during the Great Crusade. His record earns him a place in the Mournival, the Warmaster’s informal circle of advisers. The fleet also carries remembrancers, including Euphrati Keeler, Kyril Sindermann and Ignace Karkasy, whose experiences offer a human view of conquest.

Campaigns against a human empire and on the world of Murder expose the limits of Imperial certainty. The appearance of an enemy that does not fit the rational Imperial Truth troubles Loken. Contact with the interex offers the possibility of a different relationship with a human civilisation, but a theft and the violence that follows undermine negotiations.
detailed: The expedition attacks a human civilisation whose ruler claims the title of Emperor. Loken’s actions during the campaign establish his standing within the Luna Wolves, but the conquest also raises questions about the Great Crusade’s assumptions. Horus, newly appointed Warmaster after the Emperor’s withdrawal to Terra, must combine military command with diplomacy and political judgement.

Following the death of Hastur Sejanus, Loken is brought into the Mournival alongside Abaddon, Aximand and Torgaddon. He gradually discovers the difference between formal command and the private advice Horus seeks from his sons. Human observers aboard the fleet attempt to record and understand the crusade; their proximity to the warriors does not make them immune to its costs.

During fighting in the Whisperhead Mountains, the warrior Xavyer Jubal becomes the host of something Loken cannot reconcile with his training. Loken kills him, while Keeler witnesses and photographs the encounter. Horus acknowledges that the warp contains dangers, but the explanation leaves much unresolved.

The expedition is drawn to Murder, where Imperial forces including the Blood Angels and Emperor’s Children have fought the megarachnid. Saul Tarvitz and Lucius are among the warriors encountered there. The interex then reveal that the world was a confinement zone and make contact with Horus’s forces.

Horus attempts negotiation with the interex rather than treating conflict as inevitable. The theft of the anathame from their collection turns suspicion into violence. The possibility of peaceful accommodation collapses, leaving the expedition with a victory that feels very different from its earlier certainties.
